description: Korean officetel (오피스텔) house-count check by tax: acquisition tax counts officetels acquired from 2020-08-12 whose property tax is levied as housing (지방세법 시행령 제28조의4); capital-gains surcharge and comprehensive real estate tax count residential use in fact (소득세법 제88조); the 2024-01-10 small new-build rule (60㎡ or less, price 600M metro / 300M elsewhere, built and first sold 2024-01-10 to 2027-12-31) removes it from acquisition, surcharge and 종부세 counts but not from the one-house exemption test; housing subscription never counts officetels. Returns each test, the officetel's own 4.6% acquisition tax and the extra acquisition tax on the next home caused by the officetel.

otherHouses.description: Houses the household owns besides the officetel
